item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother in the kitchen. A steel ladle is left resting in a pot of hot dal on the stove. After some time, the handle of the ladle becomes hot even though it is not touching the flame.
By which process does heat reach the handle of the ladle?

options.A: conduction, because heat passes through the metal from particle to particle
options.B: convection, because hot dal rises and carries heat to the handle
options.C: radiation, because the flame sends out heat in all directions
options.D: evaporation, because steam from the dal heats the metal
